prompt:
Instrumental video game race music, 4 minutes, eight clearly separated sections of exactly 30 seconds each, all at a driving 150 BPM, energetic, cheeky and chaotic cartoon-action style, no vocals. Each section is a self-contained loopable theme with a short 1 second silence at its end.
0:00-0:30 Jungle temple: tribal drums, marimba, wild brass stabs.
0:30-1:00 Gear mine: industrial clanking percussion, steam whistles, funky slap bass.
1:00-1:30 Sky islands: soaring strings, flutes, bouncy synth arpeggios.
1:30-2:00 Neon city: synthwave, punchy electronic drums, retro lead synth.
2:00-2:30 Sunken temple: underwater dubby bass, bubbly synths, reverb bells.
2:30-3:00 Sky pirates: sea shanty accordion, fiddle, stomping rhythm.
3:00-3:30 Desert ruins: middle eastern oud, darbuka drums, surf guitar twang.
3:30-4:00 Mushroom crystal cave: trippy psychedelic synths, glassy bells, wobbly bass.
